status: FROZEN before any confirmatory training. The formation, causal, quality, and distance rules are INHERITED UNCHANGED from the merged Stage B classifier (classify_stage_b.py, sha256 3ca1e75f...). Only the fresh-seed list (13-17) and the final confirmatory verdict mapping are new; no threshold is changed.
formation_rule: forming(S, A+) := needle_d96(S) >= 0.075 AND (needle_d96(S) - needle_d96(A+)) >= 0.050 AND needle_d96(S) >= 0.07
causal_rule_per_forming_seed: for k in {slots_off, randomized_address}: drop_abs = baseline - ablated; require drop_abs >= 0.050 AND (drop_abs >= 0.5*gain if gain>0 else True) AND ablated <= max(A+_d96 + 0.030, 0.050); where baseline = ablation.baseline (post-train needle@d96) and gain = baseline - A+_d96.

primary_gates.C1_form_ge_4_of_5: CR1 forms on >= 4 of 5 fresh seeds (b1)
primary_gates.C2_form_gt_B0: CR1 formation count > B0 formation count (b5)
primary_gates.C3_win_ge_4_of_5: CR1 needle_d96 > A+ needle_d96 on >= 4 of 5 seeds (b4)
primary_gates.C6_quality: mean(CR1 ppl256) <= 1.20*mean(A+ ppl256) AND <= 2 of 5 exceed A+ ppl256 by >25% (b7)
primary_gates.C7_distance: d16 no material regression (CR1 >= A+ - 0.050 all seeds) AND >= 3 forming seeds keep positive CR1-A+ at d220 (b9)
primary_gates.C8_slots_off: every forming CR1 seed collapses under slots_off (part of b8)
primary_gates.C9_randomized_address: every forming CR1 seed collapses under randomized_address (part of b8)
primary_gates.C10_integrity: frozen abc.json + code hashes unchanged; no forbidden architecture; parameter match (b6, b10, b11)

final_verdict_mapping.CONFIRMATORY_REPLICATION_FAILED: emitted iff a valid scientific run completed but any of the scientific gates C1..C9 fails
final_verdict_mapping.CONFIRMATORY_INTEGRITY_FAILED: C10 false (frozen artifact or historical evidence changed, or forbidden architecture detected)
final_verdict_mapping.CONFIRMATORY_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH: the runtime environment is incompatible with producing a valid comparison
final_verdict_mapping.CONFIRMATORY_RESOURCE_BLOCKED: compute unavailable so no valid scientific run could be produced (e.g., torch cannot be installed / trained)

hard_rules: A higher mean with < 4/5 formed does NOT pass (C1 mandatory).
One causally-unclean forming seed fails the whole replication; causal results are NEVER averaged across seeds.
PROVISIONALLY_STABILIZED is NOT a valid confirmatory verdict.
No best-checkpoint selection; the classifier uses only the step-1200 evaluation.
